source_title: Girl, 6, critical after boy, 8, bangs her head against desk, repeatedly hits her with brick and kicks her - The Times of India
source_excerpt: PANCHKULA: A six-year-old girl was critically injured after an eight-year-old boy assaulted her inside a classroom at a school in Panchkula on Wednesday.The girl has been admitted to the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER) in Chandigarh, where she is undergoing treatment, police said on Friday.A purported video of the incident circulating on social media shows the boy allegedly grabbing the girl by her hair and repeatedly banging her head against a desk.After she falls to the floor, he is seen kicking her, dragging and hitting her with a brick. The girl is seen bleeding in the footage.DCP (Crime) Amrinder Singh confirmed that the boy is eight years old and the girl is six.
